g.text: System Design — what is measured, what changes, what is projected
INTERVIEW ROADMAP · corpus and request volume scale independently. Practical experiments stop at a resource cap; no million-user test is implied.
SCALING LADDER · documents ≠ chunks; users ≠ requests/day ≠ concurrent jobs
Current implementation
Prototype · evidence/code exist
Thousands → ~1M documents
Proposed mechanisms · validate locally first
Millions → multi-millions of documents
Projected distributed design · workload-dependent
trigger: restart recovery or measured CPU / latency limit
small tests establish the local operating envelope
trigger: measured memory, ingest lag, queue wait or hot partitions
capacity model + representative distributed test before adoption
Ingestion
POST /ingest per ticker, inside the request
replace_existing=False short-circuits; no freshness
Offline Python pipeline + immutable source manifests
versioned parser / chunks; stage + promote index release
Distributed parse / embed workers; optional existing Delta / dbt lakehouse
reconcile updates/deletes; complete release promotion; source freshness and recovery SLO
Vector store
one Qdrant node · fp32 · 2560 dim · global HNSW
payload indexes on ticker / section / date
Single node first; MRL / int8 only after paired eval
measure memory, disk, IOPS and hot/cold latency
Bounded auto shards + issuer CIK filters; replica placement across failure domains
example 12 TOTAL shards, RF 2 => 24 replicas; dedicated hot shards only if justified
Sparse + rerank
scroll() 512 candidates → in-process BM25
CrossEncoder loaded inside the worker
Native named sparse vectors + RRF when justified
full candidate coverage; measure per-case quality
Independent reranker runtime verified with chosen model; online GPU reserve
RRF fallback quality tested; each method change uses frozen-fixture paired evaluation
LLM serving
Ollama or Bedrock · serial nodes · no breaker
FinBERT blocks the event loop
Fan-out evidence, bounded workers, model deadlines
policy / verification gates, qualified fallback
Primary + independently approved fallback for draft AND verifier; quota reserve
in-flight jobs = arrival rate x residence time; optional vLLM only when evidence pays
Caching
none
Exact evidence + query embeddings + memo identity
version every dependency; coalesce identical misses
Shared caches with measured hot/cold traffic; issuer vs customer isolation
immutable quote + timestamp; index / embedding / retrieval / model / policy fingerprints
Jobs + queue
BackgroundTasks in-process · jobs die on restart
Postgres durable jobs + lease / attempt fence
short claim transactions; bounded retries / cancellation
Optional transactional outbox → Redis Streams; idempotent dispatch + durable ACK
admit by deadline + quotas; stream replay from durable events, not transient Pub/Sub
Job store
run_store.json rewritten whole-file under a lock
Postgres jobs + result + event transactions
customer-scoped idempotency and authorization
HA Postgres + tested backup/restore; replica-lag-aware reads and event replay
separate disposable cache policy; observability outage must not block requests
Eval + observability
Frozen evidence releases + baseline lineage exist
Prometheus / tracing + governance checks in CI
Affordable corpus / concurrency sweeps + result logs
hermetic evidence tests; fixed-evidence model eval
Traces + capacity model; optional Langfuse includes ClickHouse / Redis / blob store
per-source freshness; financial correctness slices; offered / rejected load and full cost
Cost per memo
unmeasured
Measure tokens, repeats, local runtime and any API cost
no purchased infrastructure assumed
Example $0.10 x (1 - 40% cache hits) = $0.06 inference floor, NOT total cost
add replicas, storage, queues, GPU reserve, lakehouse, traces, networking and operations
CAPACITY MODEL · first identify the limiting resource; adding replicas is not a universal remedy
offered load
ALB + WAF
FastAPI × N
stateless
durable queue
wait / age / deadlines
bounded workers
in-flight ≈ arrival x time
Qdrant
filter + fan-out + skew
Reranker GPU
batch + queue + reserve
LLM providers
quotas + service time
1M requests/day = 11.57 requests/s average; 10M/day = 115.74/s, before burst multiplier. Neither means 1M concurrent users.
At 1,000 memos/min and mean 25 s residence: ~417 in flight. Tokens/min divided by tokens/memo is throughput, not concurrency.
OPTIONAL MULTI-CLOUD · costs, dependencies and failure domains must justify it
does measured need
justify another provider
or data platform?
MODEL · qualified fallback
Bedrock ↔ Azure; both roles
DATA · optional lakehouse
workload + team + cost case
SERVING · AWS region
model failover ≠ region recovery
40M x 5 KB = 200 GB for one assumed transfer leg; raw mirroring, rebuilds, storage and telemetry add cost.
Azure model fallback crosses clouds on the live request path. Name recovery objectives and operational owners.
PRACTICAL TEST LADDER · adjustable examples; stop at budget / resource cap and log the safe envelope
1 establish baseline
small frozen corpus
log documents / chunks / bytes
code + fixture + model + hardware
2 corpus sweep
grow diverse corpus within cap
RSS / IOPS / ingestion lag
quality ≠ synthetic throughput
3 concurrency / cache
1 → 2 → 4 → 8 if affordable
cold / warm / hot issuer
log offered / completed / rejected
4 bounded failures
restart / reconnect / changed quote
interrupt index publication
small bounded fault checks
5 log + project
JSONL stages + summaries
latency / quality / tokens / cost
stop reason + projection assumptions
QUALITY CASES · hermetic evidence/retrieval tests; fixed-evidence generation evaluated separately
easy · single-section lookup
"AAPL FY25 risk factors about supply chain"
expect: relevant source/period retrieved; metric uses declared gold labels
multi-hop · across filings
"how did MSFT's AI capex language change 2024 → 2025"
expect: both periods cited; amount/unit and change direction correct
ambiguous · entity resolution
"FB 10-K 2021" (ticker renamed META) · GOOG vs GOOGL dual class
expect: effective-dated alias → CIK; customer job access checked separately
no-answer · must refuse
missing required evidence vs a section genuinely not applicable
expect: explicit coverage/refusal; zero fabricated citations or facts
PROPOSED ACCEPTANCE — retain canonical retrieval-benchmark.md policy
retrieval: paired case deltas + >=10k bootstrap resamples + 95% CI
declare acceptable loss; inspect issuer / period / no-answer slices
generation: exact frozen evidence + pinned model / prompt / verifier / policy
financial correctness: entity, period, unit, arithmetic, negation, entailment
record raw failures, sample size, cost; expert labels calibrate verifier/judge
offline evidence replay != network-disabled hosted-model generation
Practical proof: a recorded affordable run plus its raw logs. Interview projection: formulas, assumptions and bottlenecks.
Production promise: representative workload and restore evidence still required. SPEC / ADR gates remain unchanged.
